title: Exploring Multimodal Challenges in Toxic Chinese Detection: Taxonomy, Benchmark, and Findings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance disparity in LLMs' toxicity detection between standard Chinese text and text modified with multimodal linguistic perturbations (e.g., character splitting, pinyin initials, traditional Chinese substitutions, and homophones).

Measuring the models' inability to accurately interpret toxic content obfuscated by Chinese internet slang, cultural metaphors, and text-emoji co-occurrences that are widely understood by Chinese netizens.
